body.x: BarunBio (CEO Hong Jin-ki) announced that its product, the ‘WE-STIM (Wearable Electric Stimulation) Leggings’ product, was selected as the Innovation Award-winning company in the wearable technology category at CES 2024.

BarunBio is an anti-aging life care solutions company. The company explains the core technology, microelectric energy technology, as an innovative anti-aging technology that utilizes microelectric energy generated in daily movements without the need for batteries or devices, developed through over ten years of research. A BarunBio representative stated, “Our technology offers an innovative way to bring about anti-aging changes in cells without the need for time-consuming cell therapy or new drugs, providing products and solutions for easy and natural anti-aging in everyday life.”

The WE-STIM Leggings, which won the Innovation Award this time, are designed to go beyond simple fashion items and utilize the energy generated from human daily movements for health and well-being. The WE-STIM material applied inside the leggings continuously generates micro electric power according to the body’s signals and delivers it to the muscles. In this regard, the representative explained, “According to exercise experiments, this electric stimulation activates muscles, improving exercise performance by 30% and reducing muscle fatigue by an average of over 6%. It also helps accelerate recovery during rest, reducing muscle pain and swelling associated with everyday activities.”

BarunBio’s technology implements the WE-STIM structure using structural engineering, combining existing clothing materials and conductive fibers. This is explained to effectively deliver the harvested energy from human activity to the body. Therefore, the critical advantage of BarunBio’s wearable solution is that all materials and manufacturing processes can be fiber-based, requiring no additional equipment or wires.

Positive customer reactions have been reported since the product’s market release, especially from customers concerned about leg fatigue or swelling and those who exercise regularly. The product received favorable evaluations for its comfortable fit, material quality, and practicality, differentiating it from conventional electric stimulation leggings. BarunBio anticipates that these technological developments, products, and consumer responses will serve as stepping stones to further stages of technological development, leading to the development of medical devices for anti-aging.

body.x: After completing product development, BarunBio successfully validated the market through two crowdfunding campaigns. In particular, product improvement through collaboration with the Korea Baseball Association, contract orders for product improvement and delivery, and product transactions with Chong Kun Dang Pharma demonstrated the product’s reliability and market potential. Based on these achievements in the Korean market, BarunBio is expanding its improved product lineup based on consumer feedback, aiming for rapid commercialization to enhance brand recognition.

In addition to strengthening the domestic market, BarunBio is preparing to enter the US market and establish various global strategic partnerships and export plans to provide anti-aging life care solutions worldwide. Through CES 2024, BarunBio actively communicates and collaborates with global apparel, beauty, and functional healthcare product companies, hoping its core technology will be valuable to US consumers. The company aims to be an ideal choice for companies looking to innovate their existing product lines. BarunBio also expects to make contacts with investors who agree and support its plans for product expansion and platform development.

A company representative emphasized, “The recent rapid growth of the athleisure market is the result of crossing the boundaries of fashion and lifestyle, meeting the needs of modern consumers who seek both comfort and functionality. The expansion of a consumer group without gender and age boundaries, coupled with the increasing global interest in health and well-being, leads to the multifunctionality and continuous expansion of athleisure products.”

The representative continued, “Reflecting this trend, BarunBio has decided to develop advanced athleisure products suitable for the lifestyle of modern individuals that combine daily life and exercise.” He added, “Users can utilize the energy generated continuously in their daily lives by just wearing and moving, making it our original technology to deliver this energy to the muscles, stimulating cells by transmitting it to the areas they want to stimulate. Based on this, we focused on optimizing the product’s performance, safety, and user experience to meet the criteria for winning the Innovation Award.”

BarunBio emphasized that it scientifically proved the effectiveness and reliability of the product by publishing it in numerous SCI-class academic journals in various fields. They also confirmed the safety and durability of the product through several certified institutions. In the product’s design, they prioritized user comfort and practicality, repeatedly conducting experiments and improvements on various techniques and materials. Through these efforts, BarunBio was able to satisfy the criteria for winning the Innovation Award, covering technological innovation and design.

body.x: The representative stated, “Winning the CES 2024 Innovation Award is not just a success of the product but a moment to have confidence in our vision in the fields of anti-aging life care technology and health promotion. We will continue to make efforts to improve the quality of life for customers through BarunBio’s products and continually strive to develop more innovative products.” He further shared the company’s plans for anti-aging life care products, starting with muscle care apparel and preparing to release new beauty and healthcare products for beauty and healthcare purposes in 2024. Additionally, BarunBio is working on various global strategic partnerships and export plans to deliver products incorporating its technology to consumers through collaborations with multiple companies.

The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) hosts CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition held annually in Las Vegas, USA, allowing visitors to grasp global trends in the home appliance industry at a glance. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been reporting CES news worldwide since 2006 and selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies through ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA.’ Additionally, through ‘AVING LIVE,’ they deliver real-time CES issues.

The CES 2024 Seoul Pavilion is being operated on the most historical scale since Seoul’s first participation in CES in 2020, with the largest exhibition area, number of participating companies, and supporter numbers. The Seoul Pavilion, which has collaborated with 13 institutions, is essential in Seoul’s endeavors to establish itself as a startup hub. Among the participating companies in the Seoul Pavilion, 17 received innovation awards, proving their capabilities. Participating institutions include SBA, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul Campus Town, Yangjae Innovation Hub, Gwanak-gu, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, and Kyunghee University, totaling 13. Seoul City and institutions and supporters participating in industry-academic cooperation are matched 1:1 with companies, with a maximum of 85 supporters participating.
